info.title: Dicloak Local API
info.description: API for controlling the local Dicloak client, providing environment management, RPA automation and related features.

tag.name: profile
tag.description: Profile is a main entity of the application. It stores all the information that needs to be saved in browser to change your fingerprint.

tag.name: profile-group
tag.description: "Profile group" refers to the management of profile groups in dicloak; It is not the case of member grouping or any other kind of thing.

tag.name: rpa
tag.description: RPA refers to the execution of specified advanced automation capabilities in Dicloak; such as cookie robots, YouTube browsing, etc.

tag.name: proxy
tag.description: Proxy in Dicloak is a separate entity that belongs to a profile but also can be managed separately for convenience.

tag.name: member
tag.description: Members generally refer to the list of team members managed by the administrator. They have different groupings, deactivation policies, etc.

servers.description: Dynamic address of the local Dicloak client.

get.description: Return a paginated list of environments or all environments. Supports pagination and filters (e.g., name, group_id, status).

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Whether to return all data (boolean, optional)

get.description: Retrieve detailed information for a single environment by envId.

patch.description: Open the environment specified by envId (set it to open state and perform necessary initialization).

delete.description: Perform a soft delete for the specified envId (moves to recycle bin).
Permanently delete the specified envId and all associated data. Use with caution.

post.description: Recover a previously deleted environment. Accepts a simplified RecoverEnv structure and can restore from recycle bin or to a specified state. The request body may include fields such as code, data, msg, and next.

patch.description: Perform connectivity and geolocation checks on provided proxy parameters. Accepts ProxyCheckReq structure and returns results (proxy check info is included in ApiResp.data).

requestBody.description: ProxyCheckReq request body (fields required for proxy checking)

get.description: Return a paginated list of environment groups or all groups. Supports pagination and filters such as env_id, member_id, name.

post.description: Create a new environment group. Accepts a request body defined by PutEnvGroup (member_ids, name, remark).

get.description: Retrieve detailed information for an environment group by ID.

put.description: Update the environment group specified by ID. Accepts a request body defined by PutEnvGroup (member_ids, name, remark).

delete.description: Delete the environment group specified by ID. The request body includes del_env to indicate whether to also delete environments inside the group (true/false).

get.description: Paginated retrieval of roles. Supports filters such as page_no, page_size, all, detail, member_id, name, remark.
Retrieve detailed information for a member by ID.

put.description: Update the member specified by ID using the full or partial MemberEditReq structure (PUT).

patch.description: Partially update the member specified by ID using MemberEditPatchReq (PATCH).

requestBody.description: MemberEditPatchReq request body (same as MemberEditReq but for PATCH)

delete.description: Delete the member specified by ID (soft or hard delete is determined by backend logic).

get.description: Paginated retrieval of members. Supports filters such as page_no, page_size, all, authority, detail, start_create_time, end_create_time, env_group_id, role_id, status, user, remark.

post.description: Create a new member. Accepts MemberEditReq structure (agent_id/all_env_group/authority/email/env_group_ids/manager_id/name/passwd/phone/remark/role_id/status/type).

Switch the current session/context to the organization specified by ID (switch logic handled by the backend). Request body may be empty. Important: switching organizations will restart the Dicloak Local API service and may temporarily disable Dicloak Local API capabilities; proceed with caution.

requestBody.description: ChangeOrg request body (schema only contains ApiKey and is ignored; additional fields are allowed)

200.description: Result of the switch organization operation

get.description: Retrieve detailed information for a proxy by ID.

put.description: Update the specified proxy information. Supported fields include host, ip_type, out_ip, passwd, port, remark, status, type, user_name.

requestBody.description: ProxyEditReq request body (host, ip_type, out_ip, passwd, port, remark, status, type, user_name)

delete.description: Delete the proxy specified by ID.

get.description: Paginated retrieval of proxies. Supports filters such as all, detail, env, host, id, remark, serial_num, type.

post.description: Create a new proxy. Required fields: type, host, port. Optional fields: remark, user_name, passwd.

requestBody.description: ProxyCreateReq request body (type, host, port, remark, user_name, passwd)

get.summary: Query RPA batch results by batch ID
get.description: Query the execution results of an RPA automation by the provided batchId.

200.description: Query successful. Returns RPA automation results.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information for an RPA task by taskId.

headless.description: Whether to open in headless mode

CreateEnvironmentRequest.description: Full environment creation request. The server does not auto-complete fields: the caller must send a complete request body. Recommended flow: 1) use the full_default_template as a base; 2) replace required fields (name, browser, group_id); 3) send the request.

name.description: Environment name (must be provided by the user, or use an auto-generated placeholder).

group_id.description: Group ID (required). If unknown, call GET /v1/env/group and use the id of the group with is_default = true.

group_ids.description: List of group IDs (for backward compatibility).

ua_os.description: UA operating system used for UA selection.

ua.description: User-Agent string. If omitted, a random UA is used. Random UAs follow formats like Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/121.0.6134.0 Safari/537.36.

config.description: Fingerprint configuration (JSON string). If using the default template, keep this field as the default JSON string. For numeric values (e.g. canvasValue) generate a reasonable 5-digit integer if randomized. Other types (truth or noise) can keep the default values.

data_config_option.description: Data configuration options, usually an array of integers.

browser_config_option.description: Browser configuration options, usually an array of integers.

local_data_config.description: Compatibility field, usually a JSON string.

proxy_soft_enable.description: Whether the proxy provider reads configured accounts.

EnvAccount.description: Single environment account entry, used to pre-install account information when creating an environment.

id.description: Account ID (generated by server or database).

url.description: Associated login page or resource link.

envId.description: Associated environment ID (can be used for binding if provided at creation).

proxyHost.description: Specify proxy IP or proxy identifier (optional).

secret.description: 2FA or other security secret (sensitive, write-only for creation).

del_env.description: Whether to also delete environments in the group

email.description: Account used for login. When creating an EXTERNAL member, a valid email format is required and an email will be sent.

env_group_ids.description: Environment group IDs the member has access to. Retrieve IDs from the environment group API.

passwd.description: Member password. Important: required when creating INTERNAL members; not required for EXTERNAL members.

role_id.description: Member role ID; obtain via role management API.

disuse_enable.description: Whether member disable feature is enabled (default false). True means disable feature enabled; false means disabled.

disuse_time.description: Member disable time, used with disuse_enable. Example: 2025-11-21 18:31:47

expiry_mode.description: Member expiry mode, default INSTANT. INSTANT means immediate; LONGIN_START means effective after first login.

expiry_time.description: Member expiry days, used with expiry_mode=LONGIN_START. Number of days after activation before expiry, default 30

time_zone.description: Member timezone. For China usually Asia/Shanghai; set according to user's network environment to display correct local time on login.

email.description: Account used for login. When creating an EXTERNAL member, a valid email format is required and an email will be sent.

env_group_ids.description: Environment group IDs the member has access to. Retrieve IDs from the environment group API.

passwd.description: Member password. Important: required when creating INTERNAL members; for PATCH, md5 hashing of provided password is needed for INTERNAL members; not required for EXTERNAL members.

role_id.description: Member role ID; obtain via role management API.

disuse_enable.description: Whether member disable feature is enabled (default false). True means disable feature enabled; false means disabled.

disuse_time.description: Member disable time, used with disuse_enable. Example: 2025-11-21 18:31:47

expiry_mode.description: Member expiry mode, default INSTANT. INSTANT means immediate; LONGIN_START means effective after first login.

expiry_time.description: Member expiry days, used with expiry_mode=LONGIN_START. Number of days after activation before expiry, default 30

time_zone.description: Member timezone. For China usually Asia/Shanghai; set according to user's network environment to display correct local time on login.

ChangeOrgReq.description: Empty object here; additional properties are allowed.
